gloss: full picture; whole aspect; entire scope

definitions.gloss: full picture; whole aspect; entire scope; complete picture
definitions.explanation: The complete view or entirety of something, especially when it is complex or not easily seen all at once. Often used when discussing investigations, projects, or situations where the full extent is being revealed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: The full picture of the incident became clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{見|み}えていない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The full scope of the plan is not yet visible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧、⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になってきた。
examples.english: As the investigation progressed, the full extent of the damage gradually became clear.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all, entire) and {貌|ぼう} (appearance, aspect). Literally "the entire appearance." Used when talking about understanding or revealing the complete picture of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the full picture becomes clear
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧: to reveal the full picture
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: the full scope is visible
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧: to grasp the complete picture
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解明|かいめい}する→解明する：26852_kaimeisuru⟧: to clarify the entire scope

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: the whole — more general and everyday
- {全貌|ぜんぼう}: full picture — more literary, implies revealing something complex
- ⟦{概要|がいよう}→概要：06747_gaiyou⟧: overview — a summary rather than the complete picture
- ⟦{大局|たいきょく}→大局：21554_taikyoku⟧: big picture — the overall situation from a strategic viewpoint
